exposure: individual educational information session with motivational interview techniques for immunization of infants during postpartum stay
cohort: Families with infants were divided into an experimental group (receiving an educational information session) and a control group (not receiving it), totaling 1140 and 1249 families respectively.
finding: An educational information session about immunization based on motivational interview techniques conducted during postpartum hospitalization significantly improved infant immunization, resulting in a 9% higher chance of complete vaccination status between 3 and 24 months in the experimental group compared to the control group.
